title: Northgate Optical Remake Billing Standard: Late Prescription-Change Remake Charge and Waiver
content:
For a Northgate Optical prescription-change remake, the late prescription-change remake charge and the waiver owed against the booked remake charge are calculated as follows.

## 1. Days past the window

The days past the window are the calendar days from the window start to the opening date of the prescription-change remake, the window start being day 0, less the prescription-change remake window of the lens design the job carries. The window start is the dispensed date of the job. The opening date of the prescription-change remake is the date of its remake charge entry carrying the prescription-change reason.

## 2. The late prescription-change remake charge

A prescription-change remake that is not past its window costs nothing. A prescription-change remake past its window costs the outside-coverage remake percentage of the lens design the job carries, applied to that design's base lens price, plus a lab handling fee of 9.95, rounded to the cent.

The late prescription-change remake charge is worked out in this order: the late percentage of the base lens price is taken first and any re-billed material amount is added to it; that sum is reduced once by the late prescription-change loyalty reduction and the fresh-prescription reduction combined into one percentage, the two never applied one after the other; the lab handling fee is then added; and the result is floored at zero and rounded to the cent once.

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Late percentage | the outside-coverage remake percentage of the lens design the job carries |
| Re-billed material amount | 0.00 |
| Late prescription-change loyalty reduction | 0 percent |
| Fresh-prescription reduction | 0 percent |
| Lab handling fee | 9.95 |

## 3. The waiver

The waiver is the booked remake charge, less every waiver already posted against it, less the late prescription-change remake charge, never less than zero, rounded to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses job: base lens price 149.99, outside-coverage remake percentage 40 percent, prescription-change window 90 days; dispensed 1 February 2025)

| Remake opened | Day | Days past the window | Late charge | Booked remake charge, net of waivers | Waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May 2025 | 103 | 13 | 149.99 multiplied by 40 percent is 59.996, plus 9.95, is 69.946, rounded to 69.95 | 79.99 | 10.04 |
| 15 May 2025 | 103 | 13 | 69.95 | 60.00 | 0.00 |
| 1 May 2025 | 89 | none (within the window) | 0.00 | 59.99 | 59.99 |
